finalists.label: Adenomatoid tumor
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and detailed evidence from the pathological examination, including spindle cells and cords of epithelioid cells around numerous blood vessels, and positive immunohistochemistry results.

finalists.label: Adnexal tumor
finalists.why: This candidate has a broad range of evidence from imaging studies, including transabdominal sonography, computed tomography, and laparoscopic findings, which all support the presence of an adnexal tumor.

finalists.label: Parovarian Cyst
finalists.why: This candidate has some evidence from imaging studies, including a hypoechoic mass and a round and smooth surface mass arising from the isthmus of the right tube, which could be consistent with a parovarian cyst.

frontier_selector.why: The champion, Adenomatoid tumor, is chosen because it has the most specific and detailed evidence from the pathological examination, which outweighs the more general evidence for Adnexal tumor.
